facts.fact: Justice minister Yacine Fall said the e-justice platform used by Senegal's courts integrates the electronic signature of magistrates and clerks, with traceability and checks of document authenticity.
The justice minister said Senegal has a legal framework including the law on electronic transactions, which recognises the legal value of digital documents.

The e-service de la justice portal, interoperable with the e-Sénégal single counter, offers in its pilot phase criminal-record extracts, nationality certificates and the permis de communiquer, per the justice minister.
The justice minister said the e-justice platform is now used as the working application by Senegal's courts, where magistrates and clerks process case files in one digital environment.
